reviews.text:
This is a shop I always stop by before going home for the holidays.

My family's Chihuahua clearly shows a different level of enthusiasm only when it's K9!

They have a wide selection, making it easy to find food that suits your dog.

The store isn't large, but it has a wide variety of treats and supplies, and I think the selection is good.

However, the display of dog and cat canned food is confusing, and I actually ended up buying three cans of cat food. (See attached image)

Some cat products are mixed in with the dog products, making it easy to overlook them.

Also, when I went to return an item the next day, I found an item without a price tag in the store, so I asked the cashier, "How much is this?" Before telling me the price, I was asked, "Do you need a bag?"

While the staff's service itself was polite, I think the store would be more user-friendly if they improved the way products are displayed and the pricing is shown.
Lovely selection. Nice staff. Pleased with the item we bought. Here is our cat, Torikatsu, modeling our purchase.

It's a small shop, but they have everything I want! 💖
The staff are always so helpful.
It's easy to get to from inside Hikarie, and they have so many cute things, seasonal items, snacks, and toys that I always end up buying a lot! ‼️ …

This is a shop I've always wanted to visit since getting a dog ✨ My wish has finally come true. They have a great selection of products, including some premium treats I've never seen before. I bought some chicken breast. It might be a little pricey.

Perhaps due to its location, the prices are on the higher side, but they do carry snacks and pet food.

Because of space limitations, the staff don't patrol the shelves, so you buy what you like.

If you're looking for something high-end and natural, this is a good option.

They also have toys and leashes.

There was a lovely young staff member who was very friendly. My Japanese isn't very good, but she patiently translated and introduced the products to me. She even bought a lot of toys that my dog ​​liked! 😍 I'll definitely shop here again next time I'm in Japan! …

I used this service to buy something for my 11-month-old puppy.

I also got a sample of dog food.
I accidentally bought the wrong size of clothing, but when I called, they were very kind and helpful. I was so relieved because I really liked the item. Thank you so much.

The selection was better than I expected.
However, I'd recommend it if you already know what you want to buy, rather than consulting with the staff about food.
In stores that sell food, the staff usually approach you and help you choose while discussing allergies and dietary needs, but here they don't offer any customer service.
They just stand at the register and don't even say "welcome" even when customers are watching.
If it's a convenience store style, self-checkout would be fine, and even though it's in Hikarie, I wonder if they haven't received any customer service training...
It was a bit disappointing.
It's expensive. The snack selection is great.

P2 DOG & CAT is a store that provides total care for pets, and is renowned for its high-quality service and extensive product selection. The store is clean and offers a wide selection of pet goods, food, toys, and more. They also offer grooming and hotel services, and are mindful of your pet's health and beauty. The staff are pet lovers and have a deep understanding of pets, so you can consult and purchase with peace of mind. The store's atmosphere is also bright and comfortable, and it's popular with many pet owners because it offers high-quality products and services with a moderate price range. If you need anything for your pet, be sure to stop by P2 DOG & CAT.
When I asked for advice about pet food, they explained everything to me very carefully.
